values.note: 25 full-service sites on a limestone base; many take 40-ft RVs, others up to 30 ft. Sites 26-35 are hike-in tent/hammock sites about 200 yards from parking (water and 20 A).

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/givhans-ferry/camping ('Many sites can accommodate 40' RVs, others up to 30''; 'Sites 26 - 35 are hike-in only'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/givhans-ferry/camping ('convenient to restrooms and hot showers'; Dump Station: Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/givhans-ferry/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/givhans-ferry/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

note: Campground on a bluff above the Edisto River. --Claude
